== Notes ==
* Aside from [[Illusion of Weakness]] when at low health, and the elite [[Blood Is Power]], this is the fastest skill to kill oneself. [[Verata's Sacrifice]] comes next.
** As of [[https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Feedback:Game_updates/20260428 Update - April 28th 2026]] - The Fastest way is  [[Awaken the Blood]], [[Masochism]] and any [[Well spell]], which will sacrifice 102% maximum health at once, provided there are no corpses to exploit.
* Synergizes well with [[scythe]]s, as well as [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can deal multiple attacks]].
* Foes in Hard Mode will use this skill even if they are the only member left of their team.
